literal: satu arah means a one-way street
jawah is the krama word for rain
ice on the ground, not in a drink

text: Jalur menika cocog kanggé ingkang nembé wiwit?
ipa: ˈdʒalʊr məˈnikɔ ˈtʃɔtʃɔɡ ˈkaŋɡe ˈɪŋkaŋ nəmˈbe ˈwiwɪt

text: Saged wangsul lumantar jalur ingkang sami?
ipa: ˈsaɡəd ˈwaŋsʊl luˈmantar ˈdʒalʊr ˈɪŋkaŋ ˈsami
